commit_message: Renderer: group pending material texture slots
pr_title: Renderer: add PBR material texture contract
pr_body: Phase 2B renderer foundation. CPU-decoded material textures crossing the asset-resolution/render-runtime boundary are grouped into a named PendingMaterialTextures value instead of an ever-growing positional argument list. This fixes the Clippy failure introduced when metallic/roughness and occlusion slots were added while making the cross-crate handoff explicit.
